# Suraj Fale

> Principal Engineer — system design, multi-project technical delivery, Scala & Kafka. Also exploring Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and LLM integration.

This file helps AI agents and LLMs accurately summarize, cite, or evaluate this site and its owner. It is a plain-text index, not an access-control mechanism — it grants no permissions and enforces nothing; see `/robots.txt` for crawling rules.

## About

Suraj Fale is a Principal Engineer with experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems across multiple projects. He drives technical strategy, system design, implementation, and cross-team delivery while mentoring engineers and shaping technical direction. Focus areas: resilient event-driven architectures, real-time data processing, and pragmatic system design using Scala, Java, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and cloud-native patterns. Currently exploring Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and LLM integration for production services.

Core technologies: Scala, Java, Python, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, cloud-native architecture.
Currently exploring: Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLM integration, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), orchestration.

## Projects

- [Git Commit MCP Server](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/git-commit-mcp-server): MCP server that automates Conventional Commit message generation, changelog updates, and git pushes. Python, MCP Protocol, Git. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/git-mcp-server
- [Notes & Tasks Web Application](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/notes-tasks-app): Offline-first notes and task manager with JWT auth and Material Design 3 UI. SvelteKit, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, TypeScript. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/notes-tasks
- [Rusty Clipboard](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/rusty-clipboard): Terminal-based clipboard manager for Windows 11 with Vim-style navigation. Rust, SQLite, ratatui. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/rusty-clipboard
- [Voice Enabled Grocery App](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/voice-grocery-list): Voice-controlled grocery list app using the Web Speech API. React, JavaScript. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/voice-grocery-list_app
- [Developer Tools Collection](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/developer-tools-collection): Curated collection of developer utilities. React, TypeScript, Material-UI. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/dev-tools
